excerpt: In 2020, Next 9.5 shipped Incremental Static Regeneration (the beta hid in 9.4 as unstable_revalidate) and it carried half the framework's marketing for years. Static speed, periodic freshness, one revalidate: 60 per page. We all internalized the model: the route is the cache unit. Next 16's Cache Components end that era. The unit is the function now, and ISR turns out to be what it always was underneath: one caching policy, hardcoded at the wrong granularity.
title: 'use cache' killed ISR
